minimal_import_principle: Distill signal ABI and a pinned ONNX runtime adapter only; do not import upstream action policy, state authority, memory or effect authority.
deterministic_control_mapping: EOT/VAD/FVAD are observations into the F2 turn controller, never direct START/STOP effects.
F2 combines acoustic VAD, DualTurn signals, semantic ASR partials and endpoint anticipation under a deterministic policy with explicit WAIT/START/CANCEL/BACKCHANNEL transitions.
Agent-playback reference must be bound to what was actually rendered/played, not merely generated TTS, to avoid corrupting overlap evidence.
Mono fallback must carry a degraded provenance flag because it removes agent-channel conversational context central to DualTurn's design.
Any threshold/sustain policy is benchmark configuration and must be persisted; upstream example threshold 0.5 plus 3-frame sustain is not canonical F2 policy.

240 ms tick: lower compute per audio-second, adds coarser decision granularity
